## Freed v26.9.903

PWA recovery, persistent device enrollment, and clearer Google Drive sync status

### Fixes

- Recognize completed Facebook logins and close the login window after healthy capture startup
- Reader, feed, and header polish
- Combine overlapping PWA Drive sync requests into one operation
- Show the time of the last successful Drive sync in Settings
- Recover storage access after a terminated browser worker without stealing another active session

### Follow-ups

- Promote enrollment recovery to production
- Prepare v26.9.902
- Promote dev into main for production release
- Facebook login recognition, reliable Saved views, and PWA recovery fixes
- Show pending enrollment accurately and record the stage of stalled Google Drive synchronization

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
